title.en: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump filed under the headings taken from Excavator
title.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机：章节取自《挖掘机》

description.en: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump is restated under Excavator. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump. The published table prints Diesel Engine 4108 / 66–75 kW; Theoretical Output 25 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 23 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.4 m³; Stone Capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m; 13 mm Stone (H / V) 60 / 180 m; 24 mm Stone (H / V) 40 / 120 m; Dimensions (L×W×H) 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm; Main Unit Weight 4200 kg; Series Note 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机放在《挖掘机》的结构下重述。邢台河北品锦机械公布柴油搅拌泵一体机。已公布参数表印有：柴油机4108 / 66–75 kW；理论输送量25 m³/h；最大出口压力23 MPa；料斗容积0.4 m³；细石输送（水平/垂直）100 / 300 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直）60 / 180 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直）40 / 120 m；外形尺寸4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm；整机重量4200 kg；系列说明30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
